title: Configurable Direct Git executable and pytest-xdist 12-worker performance profile
owner: EF01 verification; EF02 host capacity integration
objective: Tối ưu Windows Git spawn và thời gian pytest mà không làm quá tải host nhiều EF02 actions; 12 pytest workers là cấu hình thử nghiệm, không phải 12 executor.

design.current_baseline: subprocess argv uses git directly via PATH; pytest profiles serial; no pytest-xdist declared
design.direct_git: Optional explicit git executable path/GIT executable resolution; no implicit shell/wrapper/hardcoded C:\ path; fallback git on PATH
design.pytest_parallel: Optional registered pytest-xdist profile up to -n 12 only when available; serial profile remains valid; isolate temp/fixtures and perform deterministic parallel safety checks
design.host_budget: distinguish pytest worker count from EF02 max_parallel, default EF02 max_parallel=2 unchanged; avoid unconstrained 2 actions x 12 workers on limited RAM/CPU
design.measurement: record git invocation latency and serial vs 4/8/12 workers test wall-clock, memory, failures, reproducibility on actual Windows host before choosing defaults
design.fallback: if xdist missing, insufficient RAM, flaky tests, or overhead exceeds benefit keep serial and report reason

acceptance: Explicit Git path produces correct argv for all current Git calls on Windows; missing/bad path fails clearly or configured safe fallback without changing source provenance.
pytest-xdist optional profile (when installed) passes target/full tests at chosen 12 workers, with isolated temp/worktrees, no fixture race and no invented speedup claim.
Measured Windows timings and host resource observations justify chosen setting; if 12 is slower or unstable, retain smaller count or serial.
Two concurrent EF02 actions do not each overcommit unbounded pytest workers; configuration and resource limit are observable.
non_goals: Impose 12 workers on every CI job
